### 1. For the lab, can you show us what you would do for the Quality Control piece? everyone in my group did something different.

I would do something like the following. It won't be exactly what you did, but I can stack different filtering options to get a subset of the data that may not be truthful responders.

```{r}
#| eval: false

iat_filtered = iat_data %>%
  filter(edu > 13) %>%
  filter(age < 15) %>%
  filter(re_asian == 1 & re_black == 1 & re_hispanic == 1 & re_white == 1)
```
